text: The initiatives are characterized by a 'policy-to-delivery' approach, aligning national guidance with local implementation. The Wairoa Flood Mitigation Project exemplifies this through community engagement, cultural impact assessments, and a streamlined legislative pathway via the Hawke’s Bay Flood Protection Works Order 2024. The project aims to protect homes, cultural sites, and infrastructure while reducing economic losses from flooding.
